description:
HushTelegram v0.0.27 targets Telegram 13.3.1, both telegram.org's build (org.telegram.messenger.web, version code 73469) and the Google Play build (org.telegram.messenger, version code 73461), with 81 patches. Plus Messenger 13.2.2.1 takes 78 of them. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. New: a duress passcode, V2Ray-style servers, folder tabs at the bottom, videos in another player, settings in Italian and an Enter your API ID button when Telegram turns the app's ID down. Unlock Premium features is gone. Before release, 3094 runtime tests passed and 793 patch tests passed, and both patched 13.3.1 builds were walked signed in with no crashes. Needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer.

### What's new

* **Telegram:** When Telegram turns down the app's API ID at sign-in, the message now has an **Enter your API ID** button. Type the `App api_id` and `App api_hash` from my.telegram.org/apps and Telegram restarts and asks for the login code with them, so there's no repatching. The pair stays on the phone, out of settings exports and reports, and **Remove** in the same box goes back to the app's own ID. (#107, #111)
* **Telegram:** **Duress passcode** is a new switch in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, off by default. It needs a Telegram passcode. Pick a second code in **Set duress passcode**, and if someone ever makes you unlock Telegram, type that code instead of your real one. **What the duress passcode does** picks what happens next: log out every account (the default), log out only the open one, delete every account, or delete only the open one. Pick a deleting choice and a warning pops up, and it stays written under the row for as long as that choice is set. Typed the first time, the code looks like a wrong passcode and nothing happens yet. Typed again, the accounts are deleted for good, and an account with a cloud password, which Telegram waits a week to delete, is logged out meanwhile. Either way HushTelegram clears what it kept, like deleted messages, edit history and call recordings, and Telegram's downloaded media goes too. With every account gone, Telegram opens on its sign-in screen. When only the open account goes, the lists that hide or arrange your other accounts' chats stay. Your real passcode still unlocks as usual, and only a salted hash of the duress code is stored, never the code itself. (#79)
* **Telegram:** **V2Ray-style servers** is a new switch with **Free proxies** in Chat list, off by default. Paste vmess://, vless://, trojan:// and ss:// links into **Your V2Ray links** and Telegram connects through the fastest of your servers that answers, by way of a small proxy that runs inside Telegram with one entry in Telegram's proxy list. Links in **Your proxy lists** count too, base64 subscriptions included. **V2Ray server** shows how each one did, lets you pick one and tests them all again. VMess, VLESS and Trojan work over TCP or WebSocket, with or without TLS, and Shadowsocks with aes-128-gcm, aes-256-gcm or chacha20-ietf-poly1305. Links that need REALITY, XTLS, gRPC, QUIC, Hysteria, dnstt or Shadowsocks 2022 are skipped, and the row says which kinds it left out. Turning it off takes its entry out of the list and leaves your other proxies alone. Calls don't go through it. (#71)
* **Telegram:** A switch that's new since you last opened HushTelegram settings gets a small dot after its name, and so does the closed section it's in, so you can see what an update added without reading every page. Open the section and the dot moves to the new switch. Close it again, or close the settings, and the dots are gone. Search shows no dots. Nothing shows a dot the first time the settings open after you install, so the first dots come with the update after the one that adds them. (#96)
* **Telegram:** Plus Messenger can be patched too. Pick Plus Messenger 13.2.2.1 (`org.telegram.plus`, version code 22710, the APKMirror download with all four architectures) in Morphe Manager and it offers 78 of the 81 patches, each one read against Plus's own build. Plus keeps its own package, so it installs beside a patched Telegram. (#7)
* **Telegram:** View-once and self-destructing photos and videos get three new options, all off by default. **Show view-once and timed media unblurred** (Reveal spoilers) takes the blur off them in the chat. **Also allow screenshots of view-once and timed media** (Add Repeat to the message menu) lets you capture the screen that opens them, and a secret chat needs **Also allow screenshots in secret chats** as well. With **Also save view-once and timed media** on, the message menu's **Save to Downloads** shows up on them too, even when Telegram only keeps the encrypted file. (#82)
* **Telegram:** Folder tabs can now sit at the bottom of the chat list, right above the bottom bar, so they're easy to reach with one hand. Turn on **Folder tabs at the bottom** in HushTelegram settings > Chat list. It starts off, and it isn't available on Plus Messenger. (#97)
* **Telegram:** Videos in chats can now open in another player like VLC or MX Player. Turn on **Play videos in another app** in HushTelegram settings > Playback. Videos you haven't downloaded stream as they play, so there's no need to save them first, and secret, view-once and protected videos stay in Telegram's player. It starts off. (#99)
* **Telegram:** New **Always show translate bar** switch on the Conversations page, off by default. The translate bar now shows up in chats where Telegram didn't spot another language, which helps with things like Hindi typed in Latin letters. Without Premium it works through **Translate with an outside service**. If **Hide translate bar** is on too, the bar stays hidden. (#98)
* **Telegram:** New **Add Send photo to the link preview menu** switch on the Conversations page, off by default. It comes with Add Repeat to the message menu. When a link preview in the message box has a picture, its menu gets a Send photo row that sends the picture as a normal photo. Your text goes with it as the caption if it fits, otherwise it stays in the box. (#101)
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram's settings speak Italian now. Switch Telegram to Italian and every HushTelegram page, switch, search result and message follows. (#100)
* **Telegram:** New **Hide Downloads button** switch on the Chat list page, off by default. The Downloads button no longer pops up in the bar at the top of the chat list while a file downloads, and your downloads are still in the Downloads tab when you search. (#113)
* **Telegram:** New **Always show Downloads button** switch on the Chat list page, off by default. The Downloads button stays in the bar at the top of the chat list even when nothing is downloading, so your downloads are one tap away. It still steps aside while you search, and turning the switch off takes it away again without a restart. If **Hide Downloads button** is on too, the button stays hidden. Both Downloads switches take hold as soon as you close HushTelegram settings. (#113)
* **Telegram:** New **Keep downloaded stickers** switch on the Look and feel page, off by default. Telegram's automatic cache cleanup leaves sticker files alone, so sticker packs you've used don't have to download again. Clearing the cache yourself still removes them. (#110)
* **Telegram:** New **Sticker panel size** row on the Look and feel page, set to Telegram's size until you change it. Large and Larger show fewer, bigger stickers in the sticker panel and in its search results. A chat picks up a new size the next time you open it. (#110)
* **Telegram:** New **Keep emoji statuses moving** switch on the Ads page, off by default. Animated emoji statuses next to names keep playing instead of stopping after two plays, which uses a little more battery. Restart Telegram after you change it. (#112)
* **Telegram:** New **Rename on this phone** switch on the Look and feel page under **Special contacts**, off by default. It adds **Rename on this phone** to a profile's three dots menu and to the chat list's long press menu, so you can give a person, bot, group or channel a name that only your phone shows. The name shows in place of theirs in the chat list, in chats and on profiles right away, with no restart. Leave the field empty or tap **Remove** to get Telegram's name back. Telegram never gets the name. Anything you send that would carry it, like a mention, adding someone to contacts or sharing a contact, goes out with the real name, and contacts Telegram saves to your phone's address book get the real name too. Your own accounts can't be renamed, up to 50 names fit, and the names go along in a settings file. (#104)
* **Telegram:** New **Open Saved Messages on its media** switch on the Chat list page under **Hide folder tab counters**, off by default. Tapping Saved Messages in the chat list then opens its shared media page, with your saved chats, media, files, links, music and voice messages in tabs. To get to the chat itself, tap the menu on the Chats tab and pick **View as Messages**. Putting Saved Messages in a folder needs no switch, since a folder's **Add Chats** list already has it. (#103)
* **Telegram:** With **Bypass channel restrictions** on, forwarding a protected video or photo you haven't downloaded yet works better. Videos that come in several qualities were waiting on the wrong file and never went out. A download that stops now starts again, a stuck forward no longer holds up the next one, and HushTelegram tells you when it's downloading first and when the download fails. Photos that aren't on your phone download too, and **Save to Downloads** finds the quality you're watching. (#84)
* **Telegram:** **Hide pinned message bar** now reaches a chat left open under HushTelegram settings as soon as the settings close. That chat used to keep its old bar until you left the app or opened the chat again. (#85)
* **Telegram:** Patching for a root mount in Morphe Manager now starts with Repair Firebase push registration off. A mount keeps Telegram's own certificate, which is the thing that patch stands in for. You can still turn it on, and every other install starts with it on as before.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram now patches Telegram 13.3.1, telegram.org's build (version code 73469) and the Google Play build (73461). Plus Messenger stays on 13.2.2.1.
* **Telegram:** HushTelegram now builds on Morphe patcher 2.5.0, the one in Morphe Manager 2.7.0 and morphe-desktop 2.3.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.7.0 or newer before you add this release.
* **Telegram:** Remove the Unlock Premium features patch.
* **Telegram:** Remove the **Add Save to Gallery to stories** switch from Add Repeat to the message menu.
* **Telegram:** Remove the **Emoji status on this phone** switch from Hide Premium, gifts and Stars.
* **Telegram:** Remove the **Unlock Premium app icons** switch from Hide Premium, gifts and Stars.
* **Telegram:** Remove the **Move All Chats** switch from Hide folder tab counters.
* **Telegram:** Remove the **Pin chats on this phone** switch from Hide folder tab counters.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Auto-forwarding rules
patches.description: Forwards new messages others send in one chat to another by rules you set, every message or only messages with media. A forward from any account you're signed in to is never forwarded again, so rules can't loop, and at most 20 go out a minute. Starts off. Turn it on and add rules in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Black and white launch logo
patches.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Bot token sign-in
patches.description: Adds a Sign in with a bot token button to the phone number screen, so an account can sign in as a bot made with @BotFather. The bot sees a chat once someone messages it, without older history, contacts or stickers. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Bypass channel restrictions
patches.description: Lets you forward, copy and save from channels and chats that turn those off. A second switch, Open restricted channels, opens channels, groups and messages Telegram marks unavailable for copyright or local law, as long as Telegram still sends them, and offers a channel that banned you on the web. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Makes Telegram's two emulator checks always say your phone isn't an emulator. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Change sticker size
patches.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. A second switch, Keep downloaded stickers, keeps sticker files out of Telegram's automatic cache cleanup, so packs you've used don't download again. A Sticker panel size row shows fewer, bigger stickers in the sticker panel and its search. All three start off. Change them in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Chat preview buttons
patches.description: Adds Open chat and Close preview to the menu under a chat you press and hold, so the preview opens fully or goes away with one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, where Receive only mode, Power off accounts, Instant lock, Don't notify contacts and Duress passcode also live, all off by default.

patches.name: Disable call debug upload
patches.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable draft link previews
patches.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable pull to archive
patches.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable update checks
patches.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches.name: Exact numbers
patches.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Faster downloads
patches.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. A third, Faster uploads, keeps four times as many upload pieces in flight. A fourth, Download manager, runs downloads one at a time in the order you asked and adds a Downloads row to the side menu. A fifth, Send photos and videos in the best quality, sends photos in HD and videos at their own size unless you lower one first. All five start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Folders by chat type
patches.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Free proxies
patches.description: Downloads a public list of MTProto proxies, times them and keeps the 10 fastest in Telegram's proxy list, refreshed every 6 hours. Telegram connects through them unless you use a proxy of your own. The phone number screen also always has the proxy button, so you can add one before you sign in, and Proxy order puts Telegram's proxy list in an order of your own, with pinned proxies on top. V2Ray-style servers routes Telegram through your own VMess, VLESS, Trojan and Shadowsocks servers by way of a proxy that runs inside Telegram. Finding proxies and V2Ray-style servers start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. A third, Side menu, brings back a menu that slides in when you swipe right on the chat list. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide Send as button
patches.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide Stories
patches.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. A second switch, Open a folder at launch, opens the chat list on a folder you pick instead of All Chats. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide phone number
patches.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. A second switch, Don't share my number by default, leaves the share-my-number box clear when you add someone as a contact from their chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide popular apps
patches.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads. More switches there start off. Search only my chats keeps search to your own chats and contacts, with nothing public. Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones. Disable secret chats ignores it when someone asks for a secret chat, with no answer sent back.

patches.name: Hide promotional banners
patches.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide recommendations
patches.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, from the forward preview, the Share sheet or the chat picker when you pick several chats, so copies arrive without the original author. You can still turn it off in the preview or the Share sheet's send menu. Forwards to Saved Messages keep the sender. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide time on stickers
patches.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide translate bar
patches.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Holiday look all year
patches.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. Pick Telegram's own icon as the icon style to keep Telegram's icon and change only the name. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

options.description: The name under the icon, up to 30 characters. Leave it empty to keep Telegram.

HushTelegram colors is the blue badge. The plain styles draw just the H and plane, white on black or black on white, on Android 8 and up. Every style keeps the themed icon on Android 13. Telegram's own icon leaves Telegram's icon as it is, so only the app name changes.

patches.name: HushTelegram settings
patches.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon or the Telegram title at the top of the chat list. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Keep captions with their photos
patches.description: When you remove or reorder photos that each have a caption in the attach menu, every caption stays with its own photo instead of moving to the new first photo. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Lyrics and song dates
patches.description: Adds Lyrics to the music player's menu, found on lrclib.net and scrolling along with the song, and shows when you added each song to your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Message times with seconds
patches.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: My messages
patches.description: Adds My messages to a group's menu at the top, which searches the group for the messages you sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Never send an uncropped photo
patches.description: When Telegram can't finish cropping a photo, keeps the editor open and asks you to try again instead of sending the photo uncropped. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.

patches.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Proxy in the chat list menu
patches.description: Keeps Proxy in the chat list's menu, which Telegram only shows while a proxy is on or where Telegram is blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. While Keep-Alive Service is on, it runs with a quiet notification so Android doesn't stop it in the background. On by default, except for a root mount, which keeps Telegram's own certificate. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Reveal spoilers
patches.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Save downloaded files
patches.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. A third, Special contacts, adds Track this user to a person's profile menu and keeps a history of their status and profile changes on this phone. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. A second switch, Clean links when you copy or paste, does the same for a link you copy or paste into the message box. A third, No automatic sign-in on Telegram's sites, opens links to Telegram's own websites without the sign-in token Telegram adds for your account. All start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches.name: Suppress screenshot notification
patches.description: Stops Telegram from telling the other person you took a screenshot, in regular and secret chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Test server sign-in
patches.description: Shows Telegram's Test Backend box on the sign-in screen for every new account. Tick it to sign that account in on Telegram's test servers, kept apart from your other accounts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Text direction
patches.description: Adds Right to left, Left to right and Control character to the text menu of the message box, so you can set which way a line reads or add an invisible Unicode mark. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Translate with an outside service
patches.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. With an AI service, a How to translate box lets you say how you want it done. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. It also turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection, unless you've set either one yourself, so messages keep coming while Telegram is closed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Use normal paste
patches.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. A second switch, Mention by ID, turns @ and a user ID typed in the message box into a real mention of people the app has already seen. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

options.description: A Google Maps key for Android apps, made in your own Google Cloud project. Limit it to Telegram's package name and your signing certificate (SHA-1).

patches.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

options.description: The number shown as App api_id at my.telegram.org/apps. Fill in the API hash too, or leave both empty.
The 32-character code shown as App api_hash at my.telegram.org/apps. Keep it private, and fill in the API ID too.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. A second switch gives voice messages next and previous in the notification, on the lock screen and on headphones. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Auto-forwarding rules
patches.description: Forwards new messages others send in one chat to another by rules you set, every message or only messages with media. A forward from any account you're signed in to is never forwarded again, so rules can't loop, and at most 20 go out a minute. Starts off. Turn it on and add rules in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Black and white launch logo
patches.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Bot token sign-in
patches.description: Adds a Sign in with a bot token button to the phone number screen, so an account can sign in as a bot made with @BotFather. The bot sees a chat once someone messages it, without older history, contacts or stickers. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Bypass channel restrictions
patches.description: Lets you forward, copy and save from channels and chats that turn those off. A second switch, Open restricted channels, opens channels, groups and messages Telegram marks unavailable for copyright or local law, as long as Telegram still sends them, and offers a channel that banned you on the web. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Makes Telegram's two emulator checks always say your phone isn't an emulator. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Change sticker size
patches.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. A second switch, Keep downloaded stickers, keeps sticker files out of Telegram's automatic cache cleanup, so packs you've used don't download again. A Sticker panel size row shows fewer, bigger stickers in the sticker panel and its search. All three start off. Change them in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Chat preview buttons
patches.description: Adds Open chat and Close preview to the menu under a chat you press and hold, so the preview opens fully or goes away with one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, where Receive only mode, Power off accounts, Instant lock, Don't notify contacts and Duress passcode also live, all off by default.

patches.name: Disable call debug upload
patches.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable draft link previews
patches.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable pull to archive
patches.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable update checks
patches.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches.name: Exact numbers
patches.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Faster downloads
patches.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. A third, Faster uploads, keeps four times as many upload pieces in flight. A fourth, Download manager, runs downloads one at a time in the order you asked and adds a Downloads row to the side menu. A fifth, Send photos and videos in the best quality, sends photos in HD and videos at their own size unless you lower one first. All five start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Folders by chat type
patches.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Free proxies
patches.description: Downloads a public list of MTProto proxies, times them and keeps the 10 fastest in Telegram's proxy list, refreshed every 6 hours. Telegram connects through them unless you use a proxy of your own. The phone number screen also always has the proxy button, so you can add one before you sign in, and Proxy order puts Telegram's proxy list in an order of your own, with pinned proxies on top. V2Ray-style servers routes Telegram through your own VMess, VLESS, Trojan and Shadowsocks servers by way of a proxy that runs inside Telegram. Finding proxies and V2Ray-style servers start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. A third, Side menu, brings back a menu that slides in when you swipe right on the chat list. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide Send as button
patches.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide Stories
patches.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. A second switch, Open a folder at launch, opens the chat list on a folder you pick instead of All Chats. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide phone number
patches.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. A second switch, Don't share my number by default, leaves the share-my-number box clear when you add someone as a contact from their chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide popular apps
patches.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads. More switches there start off. Search only my chats keeps search to your own chats and contacts, with nothing public. Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones. Disable secret chats ignores it when someone asks for a secret chat, with no answer sent back.

patches.name: Hide promotional banners
patches.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide recommendations
patches.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, from the forward preview, the Share sheet or the chat picker when you pick several chats, so copies arrive without the original author. You can still turn it off in the preview or the Share sheet's send menu. Forwards to Saved Messages keep the sender. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide time on stickers
patches.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide translate bar
patches.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Holiday look all year
patches.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. Pick Telegram's own icon as the icon style to keep Telegram's icon and change only the name. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

options.description: The name under the icon, up to 30 characters. Leave it empty to keep Telegram.

HushTelegram colors is the blue badge. The plain styles draw just the H and plane, white on black or black on white, on Android 8 and up. Every style keeps the themed icon on Android 13. Telegram's own icon leaves Telegram's icon as it is, so only the app name changes.

patches.name: HushTelegram settings
patches.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon or the Telegram title at the top of the chat list. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Keep captions with their photos
patches.description: When you remove or reorder photos that each have a caption in the attach menu, every caption stays with its own photo instead of moving to the new first photo. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Lyrics and song dates
patches.description: Adds Lyrics to the music player's menu, found on lrclib.net and scrolling along with the song, and shows when you added each song to your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Message times with seconds
patches.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: My messages
patches.description: Adds My messages to a group's menu at the top, which searches the group for the messages you sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Never send an uncropped photo
patches.description: When Telegram can't finish cropping a photo, keeps the editor open and asks you to try again instead of sending the photo uncropped. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.

patches.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Proxy in the chat list menu
patches.description: Keeps Proxy in the chat list's menu, which Telegram only shows while a proxy is on or where Telegram is blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. While Keep-Alive Service is on, it runs with a quiet notification so Android doesn't stop it in the background. On by default, except for a root mount, which keeps Telegram's own certificate. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

release_notes:
HushTelegram v0.0.27 has 81 patches for Telegram 13.3.1, both the Google Play build (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 73461) and telegram.org's (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 73469). It moves to Morphe patcher 2.5.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.7.0 or newer before you refresh the source. Plus Messenger 13.2.2.1 can be patched now too, with 78 of the patches. New in this one: a duress passcode, V2Ray-style servers next to Free proxies, folder tabs at the bottom of the chat list, videos in another player and settings in Italian. When Telegram turns down the API ID at sign-in you can type your own right there, with no repatching. `Unlock Premium features` is gone, and so are the switches that opened Premium's paid parts on this phone.

New in this release

- When Telegram turns down the app's API ID at sign-in, the message now has an `Enter your API ID` button. Type the `App api_id` and `App api_hash` from my.telegram.org/apps and Telegram restarts and asks for the login code with them, so there's no repatching. The pair stays on the phone, out of settings exports and reports, and `Remove` in the same box goes back to the app's own ID. (#107, #111)

- `Duress passcode` is a new switch in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, off by default. It needs a Telegram passcode. Pick a second code in `Set duress passcode`, and if someone ever makes you unlock Telegram, type that code instead of your real one. `What the duress passcode does` picks what happens next: log out every account (the default), log out only the open one, delete every account, or delete only the open one. Pick a deleting choice and a warning pops up, and it stays written under the row for as long as that choice is set. Typed the first time, the code looks like a wrong passcode and nothing happens yet. Typed again, the accounts are deleted for good, and an account with a cloud password, which Telegram waits a week to delete, is logged out meanwhile. Either way HushTelegram clears what it kept, like deleted messages, edit history and call recordings, and Telegram's downloaded media goes too. With every account gone, Telegram opens on its sign-in screen. When only the open account goes, the lists that hide or arrange your other accounts' chats stay. Your real passcode still unlocks as usual, and only a salted hash of the duress code is stored, never the code itself. (#79)

- `V2Ray-style servers` is a new switch with `Free proxies` in Chat list, off by default. Paste vmess://, vless://, trojan:// and ss:// links into `Your V2Ray links` and Telegram connects through the fastest of your servers that answers, by way of a small proxy that runs inside Telegram with one entry in Telegram's proxy list. Links in `Your proxy lists` count too, base64 subscriptions included. `V2Ray server` shows how each one did, lets you pick one and tests them all again. VMess, VLESS and Trojan work over TCP or WebSocket, with or without TLS, and Shadowsocks with aes-128-gcm, aes-256-gcm or chacha20-ietf-poly1305. Links that need REALITY, XTLS, gRPC, QUIC, Hysteria, dnstt or Shadowsocks 2022 are skipped, and the row says which kinds it left out. Turning it off takes its entry out of the list and leaves your other proxies alone. Calls don't go through it. (#71)

- A switch that's new since you last opened HushTelegram settings gets a small dot after its name, and so does the closed section it's in, so you can see what an update added without reading every page. Open the section and the dot moves to the new switch. Close it again, or close the settings, and the dots are gone. Search shows no dots. Nothing shows a dot the first time the settings open after you install, so the first dots come with the update after the one that adds them. (#96)

- Plus Messenger can be patched too. Pick Plus Messenger 13.2.2.1 (`org.telegram.plus`, version code 22710, the APKMirror download with all four architectures) in Morphe Manager and it offers 78 of the 81 patches, each one read against Plus's own build. Plus keeps its own package, so it installs beside a patched Telegram. (#7)

- View-once and self-destructing photos and videos get three new options, all off by default. `Show view-once and timed media unblurred` (Reveal spoilers) takes the blur off them in the chat. `Also allow screenshots of view-once and timed media` (Add Repeat to the message menu) lets you capture the screen that opens them, and a secret chat needs `Also allow screenshots in secret chats` as well. With `Also save view-once and timed media` on, the message menu's `Save to Downloads` shows up on them too, even when Telegram only keeps the encrypted file. (#82)

- Folder tabs can now sit at the bottom of the chat list, right above the bottom bar, so they're easy to reach with one hand. Turn on `Folder tabs at the bottom` in HushTelegram settings > Chat list. It starts off, and it isn't available on Plus Messenger. (#97)

- Videos in chats can now open in another player like VLC or MX Player. Turn on `Play videos in another app` in HushTelegram settings > Playback. Videos you haven't downloaded stream as they play, so there's no need to save them first, and secret, view-once and protected videos stay in Telegram's player. It starts off. (#99)

- New `Always show translate bar` switch on the Conversations page, off by default. The translate bar now shows up in chats where Telegram didn't spot another language, which helps with things like Hindi typed in Latin letters. Without Premium it works through `Translate with an outside service`. If `Hide translate bar` is on too, the bar stays hidden. (#98)

- New `Add Send photo to the link preview menu` switch on the Conversations page, off by default. It comes with Add Repeat to the message menu. When a link preview in the message box has a picture, its menu gets a Send photo row that sends the picture as a normal photo. Your text goes with it as the caption if it fits, otherwise it stays in the box. (#101)

- HushTelegram's settings speak Italian now. Switch Telegram to Italian and every HushTelegram page, switch, search result and message follows. (#100)

- New `Hide Downloads button` switch on the Chat list page, off by default. The Downloads button no longer pops up in the bar at the top of the chat list while a file downloads, and your downloads are still in the Downloads tab when you search. (#113)

- New `Always show Downloads button` switch on the Chat list page, off by default. The Downloads button stays in the bar at the top of the chat list even when nothing is downloading, so your downloads are one tap away. It still steps aside while you search, and turning the switch off takes it away again without a restart. If `Hide Downloads button` is on too, the button stays hidden. Both Downloads switches take hold as soon as you close HushTelegram settings. (#113)

- New `Keep downloaded stickers` switch on the Look and feel page, off by default. Telegram's automatic cache cleanup leaves sticker files alone, so sticker packs you've used don't have to download again. Clearing the cache yourself still removes them. (#110)

- New `Sticker panel size` row on the Look and feel page, set to Telegram's size until you change it. Large and Larger show fewer, bigger stickers in the sticker panel and in its search results. A chat picks up a new size the next time you open it. (#110)

- New `Keep emoji statuses moving` switch on the Ads page, off by default. Animated emoji statuses next to names keep playing instead of stopping after two plays, which uses a little more battery. Restart Telegram after you change it. (#112)

- New `Rename on this phone` switch on the Look and feel page under `Special contacts`, off by default. It adds `Rename on this phone` to a profile's three dots menu and to the chat list's long press menu, so you can give a person, bot, group or channel a name that only your phone shows. The name shows in place of theirs in the chat list, in chats and on profiles right away, with no restart. Leave the field empty or tap `Remove` to get Telegram's name back. Telegram never gets the name. Anything you send that would carry it, like a mention, adding someone to contacts or sharing a contact, goes out with the real name, and contacts Telegram saves to your phone's address book get the real name too. Your own accounts can't be renamed, up to 50 names fit, and the names go along in a settings file. (#104)

- New `Open Saved Messages on its media` switch on the Chat list page under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default. Tapping Saved Messages in the chat list then opens its shared media page, with your saved chats, media, files, links, music and voice messages in tabs. To get to the chat itself, tap the menu on the Chats tab and pick `View as Messages`. Putting Saved Messages in a folder needs no switch, since a folder's `Add Chats` list already has it. (#103)

Fixes

- With `Bypass channel restrictions` on, forwarding a protected video or photo you haven't downloaded yet works better. Videos that come in several qualities were waiting on the wrong file and never went out. A download that stops now starts again, a stuck forward no longer holds up the next one, and HushTelegram tells you when it's downloading first and when the download fails. Photos that aren't on your phone download too, and `Save to Downloads` finds the quality you're watching. (#84)

- `Hide pinned message bar` now reaches a chat left open under HushTelegram settings as soon as the settings close. That chat used to keep its old bar until you left the app or opened the chat again. (#85)

Other changes

- Patching for a root mount in Morphe Manager now starts with Repair Firebase push registration off. A mount keeps Telegram's own certificate, which is the thing that patch stands in for. You can still turn it on, and every other install starts with it on as before.

- HushTelegram now patches Telegram 13.3.1, telegram.org's build (version code 73469) and the Google Play build (73461). Plus Messenger stays on 13.2.2.1.

- HushTelegram now builds on Morphe patcher 2.5.0, the one in Morphe Manager 2.7.0 and morphe-desktop 2.3.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.7.0 or newer before you add this release.

- Remove the Unlock Premium features patch.

- Remove the `Add Save to Gallery to stories` switch from Add Repeat to the message menu.

- Remove the `Emoji status on this phone` switch from Hide Premium, gifts and Stars.

- Remove the `Unlock Premium app icons` switch from Hide Premium, gifts and Stars.

- Remove the `Move All Chats` switch from Hide folder tab counters.

- Remove the `Pin chats on this phone` switch from Hide folder tab counters.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.7.0 or newer. Older Managers won't load this bundle, since it's built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram. If you already have it, refresh the source. Morphe Manager shows it as signed by d7d6 bd99 8faf 7bcc.
3. Get Telegram 13.3.1. From Google Play that's `org.telegram.messenger` with version code 73461, which [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/telegram-fz-llc/telegram/) carries too. telegram.org's build is `org.telegram.messenger.web` with version code 73469, from the [Download button](https://telegram.org/android). Once telegram.org moves past 13.3.1, Telegram's own [Telegram APKs for Android](https://t.me/TAndroidAPK) channel still has this one. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from 0.0.26? Patch 13.3.1 and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. Your settings and chats stay. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put a patched app over one signed with a different key. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram turns down your login code with `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, it's refusing the public API ID that ships with any patched build. Register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps), using only letters and numbers in the short name. Then tap **Enter your API ID** in Telegram's message and type its `App api_id` and `App api_hash`. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings, or press and hold the Telegram title at the top of your chat list.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).
